common.carousel.a11y.next: Only the Carousel.Next button carries this label, and no screen in the app renders that component.
common.carousel.a11y.previous: Only the Carousel.Previous button carries this label, and no screen in the app renders that component.
media.picker.filters.*: The native file dialog shows these file type names, and the web build has no native dialog.
profile.miniCard.a11y.anonymous: Only an anonymous profile card with a link carries this label, and the app's only anonymous card, a hidden viewer's preview in Viewed Me, has no link.
shell.notFound.clippy.*: Only in the tooltip beside clippy.avif, which has no license, and the image's alt text is on its hidden back face until it flips.
